# v0.15.0 — Blueprint generation rebuilt as a three-stage multi-loop

> The theme of this release is **splitting "one agent dumps the entire blueprint in one shot" into three focused stages: classify → topics → titles**.
> The old implementation had to classify, name every page, and attach related files within a single output budget — with many turns, the model converged early and the result was **noticeably fewer articles** (a section squeezed into one or two pages). With three stages, each stage does exactly one thing: more articles, and a single failed section no longer drags down the whole catalog.

## ✨ Blueprint: classify → topics → titles

| Stage | Execution | Output | Code-side actions |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1 Classify** | 1 agent (Repo Map global analysis) | 4–8 top-level sections (title + description) | Writes the `wiki.json` skeleton (`sections` + empty `pages`), always includes **Overview / Getting Started / Core Architecture** |
| **2 Topics** | 1 agent per section, `p-limit` concurrency | Articles for that section (title draft + related files + difficulty + group) | Assigns slug numbering and filenames centrally, dedupes within a section, merges incrementally under a file lock |
| **3 Titles** | 1 agent per section | Refined titles | Writes back `title` only; tiny output, original title kept on failure |
| **4 Articles** | Existing page generation | Markdown | **Unchanged** |

- **Slugs / filenames / numbering are managed by code** (global sequence + English stem, non-ASCII titles fall back to `page`); no longer model-dependent — URLs are stable and never drift; a file lock guarantees numbering doesn't collide under concurrent sections;
- **Incremental persistence per stage**: writes go through "file lock + temp-file atomic rename"; `wiki.json` is loadable at any moment (a skeleton with empty `pages` but non-empty `sections` is valid);
- **A failed section doesn't block the rest**: failed sections are recorded in `failedSections`, the rest produce as usual, and the generate screen shows "completed · N sections failed";
- The classify stage is fatal: if the model produces no sections, it errors out instead of pretending the catalog is done.

## 🔄 Sync is now incremental patching by change

- A file diff runs first; only **affected sections** go through the topics/titles stages;
- The topics stage reuses existing slugs + titles → **URLs of unaffected pages never drift**;
- A classify stage runs in merge mode only when new files belong to no existing page (keeps existing sections/pages, adds new ones only);
- Page states `new` / `updated` / `archived` / `unchanged` are **determined mechanically by comparing manifests in code** (no longer model-emitted); `SyncDiff` semantics match the old implementation;
- Old pages the model fails to report are kept as long as the source file still exists; archiving is judged by **actual presence on the filesystem**, so related paths like `README.md` that don't enter the scan manifest are not misjudged as deleted;
- No LLM calls when nothing changed.

## 🖥️ CLI: stage- and section-level progress on the generate screen

```text
── Catalog ────────────────────────────────────────────
⠋ Catalog                            [Topics 2/5 · Core Architecture]
── Articles 0/12 ──────────────────────────────────────
```

- Status cycles through `Classifying` → `Topics {current}/{total} · {section}` → `Titles {current}/{total} · {section}`;
- A `wiki.json` with only a skeleton (`pages` empty) now counts as "no catalog yet" on the home screen,
  eliminating the dead end of "docs generated (0 pages)" with no generate entry;
- Chinese / English strings updated in sync.

## 🧩 Contracts and new exports (all backward-compatible, optional additions)

- `WikiOutput.sections?: WikiSection[]` (derived from the page list for old `wiki.json` without the field); new `WikiSection` / `WikiTopic` types;
- `BlueprintResult` adds `sectionsCount?` / `failedSections?`; `pagesCount` is now explicitly "final page count";
- `CatalogEvent` adds `stage` / `section` / section-level `progress` / `failedSections`;
  each stage event's `usage` is the **aggregate of all finished + in-flight agents** (not one agent's snapshot);
- `@zread-pi/utils` adds persistence utilities: `initWikiSkeleton` / `mergeWikiSections` / `mergeSectionTopics` / `applySectionTitles` / `writeWikiPages` / `normalizeBlueprintSections` / `sectionsFromBlueprint` and more;
- New output tools `submit_sections` / `submit_section_topics` / `refine_section_titles`;
  the old `generate_blueprint` / `generate_sync_blueprint` remain but are no longer used by the flow (archived).

## ⚠️ Known limits

- **The classify stage is a single point**: 1 agent, and failure retries the whole stage (tiny output, low cost);
- **Slug numbering order depends on section completion order**: numbering itself is contiguous and collision-free, but order across concurrently completed sections is nondeterministic;
- **Sync's classify refresh is conditional**: it reruns only when "new files belong to no existing page";
- **Title refinement triggers page regeneration**: in sync, a title change counts as `updated` (keeps frontmatter consistent with the catalog);
- The bottom totals still **exclude** polish-agent usage under `polish.mode=full` (see v0.14.0 known limits).

## 📦 Install

```bash
# Option 1: standalone binary (zip attached to this release, unzip and run)
#   zread-pi-v0.15.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# Option 2: from source
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli config
bun run cli
```

# v0.15.0 —— 蓝图生成改为三阶段多重循环

> 本次更新的主线是**把「一个 Agent 一次性吐全量蓝图」拆成 分类 → 分主题 → 标题 三个各自专注的阶段**。
> 旧实现要在同一段输出预算里既分类、又给每页起名、再填关联文件，输出轮次一多模型就会提前收敛，
> 结果是**文章数明显偏少**（一个分类被压成一两篇）。三阶段之后，每个阶段只做一件事，文章数更充足，
> 单个分类失败也不会拖垮整份目录。

## ✨ 蓝图生成：分类 → 分主题 → 标题

| 阶段 | 执行方式 | 产出 | 代码侧动作 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1 分类** | 1 个 Agent（Repo Map 全局分析） | 4~8 个顶级分类（title + description） | 写 `wiki.json` 骨架（`sections` + 空 `pages`），强制包含 **概览 / 快速开始 / 核心架构** |
| **2 分主题** | 每个分类 1 个 Agent，`p-limit` 并发 | 该分类下的文章（标题草稿 + 关联文件 + 难度 + group） | 统一分配 slug 序号与文件名、同分类去重，加锁增量归并 |
| **3 标题** | 每个分类 1 个 Agent | 精修后的标题 | 只回写 `title`；输出量极小，失败保留原标题 |
| **4 文章** | 现有页面生成 | Markdown | **零改动** |

- **slug / 文件名 / 编号由代码统一管理**（全局序号 + 英文词干，非 ASCII 标题回退 `page`），不再依赖模型命名，
  URL 稳定、不漂移；分类并发时用文件锁保证编号不撞车；
- **每阶段增量落盘**：写入走「文件锁 + 临时文件 rename 原子替换」，任一时刻 `wiki.json` 都可加载
  （骨架阶段 `pages` 为空但 `sections` 非空也算合法）；
- **单分类失败不阻断**：失败分类记录进 `failedSections`，其余分类照常产出，生成页显示「完成 · N 个分类失败」；
- 分类阶段是致命阶段：模型不产出分类时直接报错，不再假装目录完成。

## 🔄 同步（sync）改为按变更分类增量修补

- 先做文件 diff，**只对受影响的分类**跑主题 / 标题阶段；
- 主题阶段复用既有 slug + 标题 → **未受影响页面的 URL 完全不漂移**；
- 新增文件不属于任何既有页面时，才额外跑一次分类阶段（merge 模式：保留既有分类与页面，只补新分类）；
- 页面状态 `new` / `updated` / `archived` / `unchanged` 由**代码比较新旧清单机械判定**
  （不再由模型输出 status），`SyncDiff` 语义与旧实现一致；
- 模型漏报的旧页面只要源文件仍在就原样保留；归档判定按**文件系统实际存在**判断，
  `README.md` 这类不进扫描清单的关联路径不会被误判为「已删除」；
- 无变更时依旧不调用 LLM。

## 🖥️ CLI：生成页展示阶段与分类级进度

```text
── 目录 ───────────────────────────────────────────────
⠋ 目录                                   [主题 2/5 · 核心架构]
── 文章 0/12 ──────────────────────────────────────────
```

- 状态在 `分类中` → `主题 {current}/{total} · {分类}` → `标题 {current}/{total} · {分类}` 之间切换；
- 只有骨架（`pages` 为空）的 `wiki.json` 在首页视同「尚无目录」，
  不会再出现「文档已生成 (0 篇)」且没有生成入口的卡死状态；
- 中文 / 英文两份文案同步更新。

## 🧩 契约与新增导出（全部为向后兼容的「新增可选」）

- `WikiOutput.sections?: WikiSection[]`（旧 `wiki.json` 无该字段时由页面清单推导）；新增 `WikiSection` / `WikiTopic`；
- `BlueprintResult` 新增 `sectionsCount?` / `failedSections?`，`pagesCount` 语义明确为「最终页面数」；
- `CatalogEvent` 新增 `stage` / `section` / 分类级 `progress` / `failedSections`；
  每阶段事件的 `usage` 是**所有已结束 + 进行中 Agent 的聚合累计**（不是一个 Agent 的快照）；
- `@zread-pi/utils` 新增落盘设施：`initWikiSkeleton` / `mergeWikiSections` / `mergeSectionTopics` /
  `applySectionTitles` / `writeWikiPages` / `normalizeBlueprintSections` / `sectionsFromBlueprint` 等；
- 新增输出工具 `submit_sections` / `submit_section_topics` / `refine_section_titles`；
  旧 `generate_blueprint` / `generate_sync_blueprint` 保留但不再被流程使用（仅归档）。

## ⚠️ 已知边界

- **分类阶段是单点**：只有 1 个 Agent，失败即整段重试（输出很小，成本可控）；
- **slug 编号顺序取决于分类完成顺序**：编号本身连续无碰撞，但多分类并发时先后不确定；
- **sync 的分类刷新是条件触发**：只有「新增文件未归入任何既有页面」时才重跑分类；
- **标题精修会触发页面重生成**：sync 中标题变化按 `updated` 处理（保证 frontmatter 与目录一致）；
- 生成页底部合计仍**不含** `polish.mode=full` 的 polish Agent 用量（见 v0.14.0 的已知边界）。
